About the role:

We are currently seeking motivated and reliable individuals who can work as a Harvest Picker, Production Line Worker and Irrigation Farm Hand to work at our farm in Douglas Daly, NT. These roles are essential to the continued success of our farm operations and provide a great opportunity to work in a dynamic, outdoor environment.

You will work on a casual basis at Douglas Daly, NT. 

Job Descriptions: 

As an IRRIGATION FARM HAND, you will ensure the irrigation system is working at all times to ensure the crops are receiving sufficient water.  

About the role:

•	Turns irrigation systems on and off as designated
•	Operate a RTV/Mule.
•	Replaces or repairs irrigation valves.
•	Commissioning of blocks.
•	Regular pressure checks and fixing of leaks on blocks/mainlines.
•	Installs or repairs of irrigation lines.
•	Ensures proper care in the use and maintenance of equipment and supplies.
•	Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.
•	Performing general labouring duties, such as landscaping, spraying (Knapsack) upkeep of pump sheds.
•	Perform basic recording functions such as pesticide use and water levels.
•	Provide assistance within the scope of this level to other employees as required.
•	Perform daily pre-start checks.
•	Clear and maintain irrigation ditches, as directed by supervisor.
•	Assisting with minor repairs and maintenance of vehicles, assets, and equipment.
•	Promotes continuous improvement of workplace safety and environmental practices.
•	Participating in training programs to enhance skills and knowledge related to horticultural practices and safety procedures. 


As a PRODUCTION LINE WORKER, you will assist in all-round stock controlling, picking, packing and quality assurance of produce.

About the role:
• Receiving incoming goods, checking for damage and for discrepancies between goods and packing orders.
• Unloading vehicles, opening packages, and removing contents.
• Labelling goods with details of storage location.
• Packing and weighing goods and sealing boxes.
• Assisting with regular stocktakes.


As a HARVEST PICKER, your role will include, but are not limited to:

• Picking fruit and vegetables according to size and ripeness by hand
• Discarding rotting and over-ripened produce following our quality standards
• Operating small tractors, when required
• Loading picked fresh produce into containers
• Digging and planting/transplanting seedlings by hand


To be successful in the role you will possess the following:

•	Willingness to work in various weather conditions.
•	Physical fitness and ability to perform manual labour.
•	Basic mechanical aptitude for equipment operation and maintenance.
•	Strong work ethic, reliability, and punctuality.
•	Ability to follow instructions and work as part of a team.
•	Eagerness to learn and adapt to farm-specific procedures and practices.
•	Team player who can work effectively with people from different backgrounds.
•	Awareness and ability to adhere to WHS requirements.
•	Flexibility in hours worked to achieve operational targets, including weekends, overtime and public holidays.


In return we offer you:

•	A collaborative and supportive team environment.
•	Training and development opportunities.

Number of positions available: 6
Hours per week: 30 hours per week
Commencement date: 1st January 2027 to September 2027 (9 months)
Renumeration: Starting at Level 1 $32.01/hour. If you have previous experience or after 3 months of experience on the farm, you will progress to Level 2 $33.05/hour (Horticultural Award 2020).


For more information, please email hr@rombolafamilyfarms.com.au. To learn more about working with us, we encourage you to visit our website http://www.rombolafamilyfarms.com.au

About the company

Statewide Bearings is a proudly 100% Australian-owned and operated family business, with over 50 years of expertise in the bearing and power transmission industry. As one Australia’s leading suppliers in this field, we have offices located across the country, with more than 44 locations and a team of over 500 employees nationwide. As a family owned and operated business we are committed to our people. At SWB, we prioritise our employees, promoting a supportive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and has the opportunity to grow.

About the role

We are currently seeking a motivated Sales Representative to join our Statewide Bearings team Wind Energy Team in Dandenong!
In your role, you will be responsible for supporting growth of our Wind Energy division by delivering technical service solutions, undertaking maintenance activities both in the workshop and at third-party sites, providing engineering support, and coordinating workshop and onsite service activities, while providing an exceptional level of customer service and satisfaction to all SWB customers and internal stakeholders.
This is a full-time position that offers excellent career prospects working alongside a highly motivated team. As a Sales Representative, you will report to the Wind Energy Manager and work closely with our Wind Energy Team.

About the Position

Position: Sales Representative (Industrial Products)

Location of work: 84 Greens Road, Dandenong South, VIC 3175

Employment type: Permanent, Full time.

Salary Range: $75,000 to $85,000 plus Superannuation.

Key Responsibilities

•	Work closely with customers, engineers, and technical teams to assess equipment needs and recommend suitable products or system solutions.
•	Collaborate with sales teams to assess customer needs and recommend suitable wind energy solutions.
•	Promote the SWB Wind engineering and product capabilities.
•	Provide technical presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients.
•	Prepare quotations, negotiate pricing, and manage the full sales cycle including order placement, contract negotiation, and delivery coordination.
•	Assist in preparing proposals, bids, projects and responses to RFQs.
•	Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for clients.
•	Conduct routine inspections and maintenance to ensure optimal turbine performance.
•	Train clients and internal teams on operation and maintenance procedures.
•	Schedule jobs in house and with third party suppliers.
•	Control job schedules, timelines and deadlines.
•	Work at assigned Wind Farm or workshop locations as required.
•	Promote and deliver cost effective process, solutions and savings.

To be successful in the role the applicant will need:

•	A relevant bachelor’s degree (required).
•	At least one year of experience in a similar role
•	Strong technical understanding of industrial products, machinery, and mechanical systems.
•	he ability to interpret technical drawings & schematics, and complete detailed inspection & QA reports.
•	The ability to understand and respond effectively to customer needs.
•	Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
•	High level of experience in Microsoft Excel and Word.
•	A proactive, self – motivated, and highly organised with excellent time management skills.
•	A high level of professionalism.
•	Current Driver’s License.
•	Access to a Personal Vehicle for site travel (Essential).

If you are looking to join a supportive work environment where you can grow and become the best version of yourself, apply now and start your career with SWB!

To apply, please click on the “Apply Now” button and submit both your resume and covering letter.

Experience Quality Manager for a manufacturing company based in Nowra NSW   
 Quality Manager 
   
 South Nowra, NSW $100,000 - $130,000 + Super (DOE) Monday to Friday | Flexible Start Times 
   
 We are currently seeking an experienced Quality Manager to join a growing manufacturing organisation based in South Nowra. This role offers an excellent opportunity to take ownership of quality systems within a regulated environment, supporting both compliance and continuous improvement initiatives. 
   
 About the Role 
 Reporting to the Head of Quality, you will play a key role in maintaining and enhancing Quality Management Systems (QMS) and ensuring compliance with relevant regulatory standards. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and act as the on-site Quality lead when required. 
   
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Maintain and improve QMS within a regulated manufacturing environment 
 Oversee document control, deviations, CAPAs, and change management processes 
 Support batch review and product release activities 
 Conduct internal audits and assist with external and regulatory audits 
 Lead investigations relating to quality issues, non-conformances, and complaints 
 Drive continuous improvement initiatives across the business 
 Provide training and guidance to operational teams on quality standards 
 
   
 About You 
 
 Degree-qualified in Science, Life Sciences, or a related discipline 
 Proven experience in a GMP-regulated environment 
 Strong understanding of quality systems, compliance, and regulatory requirements 
 Experience managing investigations and root cause analysis 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills 
 Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting 
 
   
 Experience within food, pharmaceutical, or complementary medicines manufacturing is highly regarded 
    
 What's on Offer 
 
 Competitive salary based on experience 
 Flexible start times (Monday to Friday) 
 Opportunity to influence and improve systems in a growing organisation 
 Supportive and collaborative team environment 
 
     If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV to david.lynes@hays.com.au, or call Dave on 0477551369 now.   If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion on your career.    Please  click here  to apply.

The role ensures all electrical work is completed safely, efficiently and in accordance with Australian Standards, statutory requirements and company procedures.            Benefits  Work vehicle   Task & responsibilities   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES   The Electrician will be responsible for, but not limited to:   Installing, testing, commissioning, maintaining and repairing electrical wiring, equipment, switchboards, lighting systems and electrical installations.  Reading and interpreting electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications and technical documentation to determine installation requirements.  Measuring, marking out and installing electrical wiring, conduits, cables and associated equipment.  Connecting electrical systems, switchboards, distribution boards and equipment to power supplies.  Testing electrical installations using specialised testing equipment to verify safety, functionality and compliance with Australian Standards.  Diagnosing electrical faults and carrying out repairs or replacing defective wiring, equipment and components.  Installing and commissioning communications cabling, data cabling, security systems, smoke alarms and associated electrical equipment.  Installing electrical components associated with air conditioning systems in accordance with applicable licensing requirements.  Performing preventative and reactive maintenance on domestic, commercial and industrial electrical systems.  Conducting switchboard upgrades, lighting upgrades, power installations and electrical fit-outs for new and existing buildings.  Ensuring all work complies with the Electrical Safety Act, relevant Australian Standards, workplace health and safety requirements and company procedures.  Liaising with clients, builders, project managers and other trades to coordinate works and ensure projects are completed on time.  Completing job documentation, testing records, compliance certificates and service reports accurately.  Maintaining tools, equipment and company vehicles in a safe and serviceable condition.    Qualification & experience   SKILLS, QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE    Essential    Certificate III in Electrotechnology Electrician (or equivalent recognised qualification).  Current Queensland Electrical Work Licence.  Minimum three (3) years' relevant post-qualification experience as an Electrician.  Demonstrated experience undertaking domestic, commercial and industrial electrical installations and maintenance.  Ability to read and interpret electrical plans, wiring diagrams and technical specifications.  Sound knowledge of the AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules and relevant Australian Standards.  Experience using electrical testing and diagnostic equipment.  Strong fault-finding and problem-solving skills.  Excellent communication and customer service skills.  Current unrestricted Australian Driver Licence.  Ability to work independently and as part of a team.    Desirable    Restricted or unrestricted Air Conditioning Licence.  Open Cabling Registration.  Experience installing data and communications cabling.  Experience installing CCTV, security and access control systems.  Elevated Work Platform (EWP), Working at Heights, CPR/LVR and White Card certifications.      About Company    Trecs Electrical Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based electrical contracting company providing high-quality domestic, commercial and industrial electrical services throughout Brisbane, Rockhampton and surrounding regions. The company specialises in electrical installations, maintenance, communications and data cabling, air conditioning installations, security systems, switchboard upgrades, lighting solutions and electrical services for new construction and refurbishment projects.
